name: Utuado (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, brown and blue — for the mountains, the fertile soils and the rivers — charged at the centre with the sun of Otoao, a Taíno sun in yellow.
history: Utuado is a town and municipality in the Cordillera Central of Puerto Rico. English Wikipedia records that the flag, coat of arms and anthem were adopted in 1987 under Mayor Waldemar Quiles; Flags of the World cites an adoption by Decree No. 24 of the 1980–1981 series.
